title: Patient Forum Question Answering
description: Question answering and response classification for patient health forum posts, categorizing responses by type (medical advice, experience sharing, information request, emotional support). NOTE: This is an illustrative task template not tied to a confirmed primary source. It does NOT correspond to SemEval-2022 Task 6 (which is iSarcasmEval, intended sarcasm detection) or to any other real SemEval-2022 task.
